text: 【英语课程】【英语课程】Hi, it's me, Jessica again.Welcome to my English class.Today, we will continue to read a story about Tom Sawyer.I hope you will like it.This is what you are supposed to learn in today's lesson.Please get your book, worksheet and notebook ready.We are going to read a story, an extract from the adventures of Tom Sawyer.Just like Tom Sawyer paints the fence, it is also from the book, The Adventures of Tom Sawyer.The word extract in the title means a piece of writing from a book.The Adventures of Tom Sawyer is a famous novel.When we read novels, getting to know the setting, character and plot is essential for us to understand what we read well.The setting of a novel is the place or time the events in a novel take place.Characters are the people in a novel.Plot is the series of events which form the story of a novel.In other words, when we read a novel, it's necessary for us to know when and where the story took place.Who the characters were, what happened in the story.Now let's take the story Tom Sawyer paints the fence you learned as an example.Do you still remember when and where the story happened?On a pleasant Saturday, on the sidewalk in the countryside, who were the characters?And these were the characters, what happened?Tom Sawyer tricked the boys into helping him paint the fence.Since you have known what to read, now let's read the story about one of Tom's adventures.Please take out your worksheet and complete the first task.请大家拿出课堂任务单,完成第一个练习。Read the story and figure out the answers to these WH questions together.When and where did the story happen?Can we get any information about when the story happened?What about where?In a cave.Besides the article, the picture can also give us some information about their experiences in the cave.What was in Tom's hand?A candle.Why was he holding that?Because it was dark in the cave.What were the things above the kid's head?They were stalactites.Who were the characters?Tom Sawyer and Becky.Good, and this is Becky.What did they do in the cave?Tom and Becky had some adventures in the cave.Good, we have got the general idea of the article.Actually, Tom and Becky's adventures happened in the different parts of the cave.Please read for the second time and find out Tom and Becky's route in the cave.I will help you get the first one.From the first two sentences, Tom and Becky walked down a winding passage.They saw names and dates written on the wall with candle smoke by other visitors to the cave.I can tell the first place is a part of the cave with names and dates on the wall.Now it's your turn.Please find out the rest of the places they have been in the cave.You can online some key information.OK, let's check the answers together.After they left the first place, they went to the part of the cave with the wall having no writing on it.Why didn't they notice the change at first?Oh yes, because they talked so much.They were so excited to enter a new place.And then what was the next place?They arrived at a place where a little stream of water was running.OK, then did they go any farther?Absolutely.They went to the deeper part of the cave.How did they make it?Through an opening in the rock.What is an opening?This picture will give you a clearer idea.Let's move on.Where did they go next?They went to a huge open space full of shining stalactites.That's really an amazing place.After that, they got to a place that was a little scary, right?They arrived at a place full of bats.Finally, they left the cave safely and that was the end of their adventure.The cave inside seems a little complicated.And I'm curious about what they exactly did or saw there.Please read through the story and find out what Tom and Becky saw or did at these places.At the very beginning of their cave adventure, they read some of the names and dates on the wall.They talked so much that they didn't even notice they had arrived at the part of the cave with no writing on the wall.They used the candle smoke to write their own names on the wall.After that, they came to a place where a little stream of water was running.They saw the cave wall which looked like a frozen waterfall.And then they went to the deeper part of the cave through an opening in the rock.They wound their way there and made smoke marks here and there to show the way back.And then they walked around a huge open space and saw stalactites as thick as a man's leg in it.After leaving the fantastic place, they got to a scary place.They found many bats and the bats flew at the candle flames at once.They escaped immediately.Mark Twain impressed the readers with detailed description of Tom and Becky's experiences in the cave.Well, after reading the two stories in Unit 5, how do you like this story?Many of you may have this impression.It's more exciting and more like an adventure story.What does adventure mean?It means an unusual, exciting or dangerous experience, journey or series of events.So why do you think it is more like an adventure story?Okay, I'd like to share my opinion.Do you remember where the story took place?Yes, in the cave.What's your impression of the cave?In my mind, the cave is a place full of mysteries for its always dark, wet and probably dangerous.So, the setting of the story reminds me of the word adventure.Can you name some other places which also remind you of adventures?Okay, let's share our ideas.An unexplored planet.The undersea world.An isolated island.A thick forest.I think they are some good examples of common setting of an adventure story.In addition to the general setting, what else makes you think it is an adventure story?Please take out your worksheet and complete the second task.请大家拿出学习任务单,完成第二个练习。Okay, I'd like to share some of my ideas.I think this is an adventure story, because the author describes a unique landscape.In the beginning, Tom and Becky walked down a winding passage.It's a very long passage.What does the winding passage mean?It means the path they took was curving and twisting.Don't you smell adventure here?Then, they came to a place where the cave wall looked like frozen waterfall because of the running water.I have seen a frozen waterfall before, so I understand precisely how beautiful it is and also how much time was spent in the process of forming it.And at last, they found a huge open space full of shining stalactites, as long and thick as a man's leg.What a spectacular view!All these points prove the fact that the cave was an ancient.Exploring in such an ancient cave must be adventurous.Besides the unique landscape in the story, what Tom and Becky did also impressed me a lot.When they started their trip, they used the candle smoke to write their names on the cave wall.Few children had such an experience.That was totally unusual.And as they wound their way into the deeper part of the cave, danger might appear at any time.In order to make sure they could find their way back, they even made marks here and there.All those things they did showed that it was a trip full of adventure.The most exciting part is definitely the appearance of the bats.Bats, in many stories, are usually connected with evil and death.Now imagine that you are in the cave too, just like Tom and Becky.You are walking on tiptoe for fear of waking the sleeping bats.However, your candle light has disturbed them, and all of a sudden, you are overwhelmed by thousands of bats.The angry bats fly at the candle flame and put out your only source of light.You scramble desperately for the exit and finally get away.Doesn't it sound like the ending of a dangerous adventure?Now we have talked about the setting and the exciting plot.Let's focus on the main character Tom Sawyer.Do you remember what Tom was like in the story Tom Sawyer Paints the Fence?He was a little lazy.He was fond of playing tricks on other people.And most of you might think he was a cunning boy.Now, after reading this one, what do you think of Tom now?Can you write down your opinions?Please take out your worksheet.请大家拿出学习任务单,完成第三个练习。Now, let's share some of my students' ideas.In this extract, he cared for his friend, Becky.He was very considerate.When they came to the stone waterfall, Tom lit it up so that Becky could see it better.What's more, when the bats appeared, Tom held Becky's hand and together they escaped from the cave.Tom showed great curiosity about the new things and was very brave.Although the cave was completely unknown to them, he still chose to explore it.When he and Becky were in the cave, he made smoke marks here and there.That indicates he was very cautious and smart.He acted like an experienced adventurer.Well, Tom is indeed very different from ordinary teenager boys.What made Tom a boy with distinctive characteristics?If you ask me the reason for Tom's unique character, my best guess is that our Tom was an orphan.Life was hard for him.He had a tough childhood, so maybe the orphan's life made Tom a little cunning and developed his habit of thinking twice before acting.However, although he was an orphan, there must be love in his life.Otherwise, he could never show such a close friendship with Becky.In order to find out more about Tom, I can't wait to read the book, The Adventures of Tom Sawyer.What about you?So much for today's class.I really hope you enjoyed it.And this is your homework today.See you.
